cfg_agent_notes_stribor: Voice and speech analysis — transcription, prosody, diarisation
cfg_agenti_uvod: Model per agent — “default” uses the tier from the registry. An override is stored in model-config.json → agentOverrides and takes effect immediately (no restart). local only = an Ollama model via API spawn — it works, but text only (no tools: Bash/files/MCP). Claude, Gemini, Kimi and OpenRouter models have FULL tools. REGOČ, Klaudio and Stribor are selectable here like the rest: Klaudio reads the override per message (no bot restart), while for REGOČ and Stribor it applies when they execute a task themselves. Message routing (which agent gets the job) does NOT go through this choice — it stays on the local Ollama classifier, which is changed in the „Classifier model" card below.
cfg_auth_ollama: A stock Ollama has no password — IP:port is enough (like RAG). A token only if it sits behind a reverse proxy.
cfg_auth_openrouter: Needs an API key (sk-or-...). Agents get FULL tools (bash/read/write) through the agentic tool loop. Billed per call.
cfg_fiksni_naslov: Permanent interface/main loop (e.g. Telegram service, orchestrator) — the model is not chosen here; the override does not apply.
cfg_kartica_dezurni: Standby — fallback model when the primary one fails
cfg_kartica_klasifikator: Classifier model — message routing (separate from the executing model)
cfg_kartica_ulaz: Ingest gate — how a Telegram message enters the board
cfg_klas_izvor_naslov: Where the value actually comes from
cfg_klas_ollama_nedostupna: Ollama unreachable — the model list is incomplete
cfg_klas_spremiste_razlika: The credential store holds a different value than the config — on a machine that loads the store into the environment, the store wins after a restart.
cfg_klas_svejedno_spremi: The setting can be saved anyway.
cfg_klas_uvod: REGOČ runs classification/routing on every message. This is NOT the same as the model an agent works with (that is the dropdown in the agent table above). The classifier must stay fast and local, so only Ollama models are offered. It is stored in {kljuc} (the credential store) and in componentOverrides.classifier; the config takes effect immediately, the environment only after the process restarts.
cfg_komp_agentcheckpoint: CHECKPOINT block with peer messages — 0 importers. AgentDaemon has its OWN, different mechanism (SQLite checkpoint table + AgentResume.ts:41); that is not this module
cfg_komp_agentcommunicationbridge: HelpPipeline → AgentSignals bridge — 0 importers; both ends of the bridge are inactive as well
cfg_komp_agentlogger: Unified JSONL logging — the only importer is AgentMonitor.ts:37, which has no callers
cfg_komp_agentpool: Warm agent pool — 0 importers; the daemons contain no pool code (grep "agentPool|warm.?pool" across RegocDaemon.ts and AgentDaemon.ts: 0 hits)
cfg_komp_agentsignals_btw: File-based signalling — the importers are AgentCommunicationBridge.ts:23 and AgentMonitor.ts:39, both without callers; ~/.tmp/agent_signals has been empty since 19 May 2026.
cfg_komp_auditlogger: Central security audit log (SQLite, 90-day retention). Reachable: TaskWebUI.ts:9363 (dynamic import)
cfg_komp_costtracker: API token usage and cost tracking per agent/task/model. Reachable: TaskWebUI.ts:39
cfg_komp_healthsnapshot: 0 callers — the promised "5 min interval" does not exist; nobody calls takeSnapshot() (the only other occurrence of the name was this very line)
cfg_komp_helppipeline: Agent-to-agent help requests — the only importer is MonitorLoop.ts:16, which itself has no callers. The live replacement is tools/consult-potjeh.ts (offered to agents from RegocDaemon.ts:2344)

cfg_komp_isagenerator: Ideal State Artifact — 0 callers; the only occurrence outside the tests is a comment in CriticGate.ts:302
cfg_komp_knowledgegraph: SQLite relational knowledge graph — the only importer is KnowledgeHarvester.ts:8, which itself has no callers
cfg_komp_knowledgeharvester: Knowledge extraction from sessions — 0 callers outside its own file and the tests
cfg_komp_modeclassifier: Effort tier routing (E1-E5) — rule-based, no AI call. Reachable: RegocDaemon.ts:55, AgentDaemon.ts:48
cfg_komp_modelrouter: AI model-agnostic routing — 4 providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Ollama). Reachable: RegocDaemon.ts:22 → LocalOffload.ts:50
cfg_komp_moduleregistry: The class itself has 0 importers; TaskWebUI reads modules/module-config.json directly (lines 6601 and 9253), so the registry is not in service
cfg_komp_monitorloop_v4_0: 7-phase loop (OBSERVE→…→LEARN) — 0 importers, imported neither by RegocDaemon nor by AgentDaemon, and no live process (pgrep -af MonitorLoop is empty)
cfg_komp_observabilitylogger: JSONL structured logging — tool calls, agent spawns, task updates. Reachable: TaskWebUI.ts:9330 (dynamic import)
cfg_komp_promptguard: Prompt injection detection (13 rules) — 0 importers outside its own file and the tests
cfg_komp_regocdaemon: Main orchestration daemon — polls MessageQueue, spawns agents, watchdog
cfg_komp_regocpulse: Unified service manager — health check, auto-restart, circuit breaker (port 17780)
cfg_komp_securitypipeline: 3 inspectors per tool call — 0 importers from code or hooks. The live L1 is ~/.claude/hooks/SecurityValidator.hook.ts (settings.json: PreToolUse + UserPromptSubmit), which does NOT use this module
cfg_komp_systemawarenessblock: 0 importers — no daemon injects this block into the prompt (grep "SystemAwarenessBlock" across .ts: only its own file and the tests)
cfg_komp_unifiedspawnpipeline: ABANDONED (ADR-0004 §5, decision O3) — 0 callers from the daemons. The verification-block builder moved to SpawnVerificationBlock.ts, which drives the live path (RegocDaemon.buildAgentPrompt + AgentDaemon.buildPrompt)
cfg_komp_wikilinkparser: [[link]] resolution — 0 importers; setup/regoc-setup.ts:83 only mentions it in a comment
cfg_login_gemini_oauth: Google discontinued the free OAuth (Code Assist) for the CLI — use an API key from aistudio.google.com/apikey (free tier).
cfg_login_otvori_opis: Open the link on any computer and approve it. If the CLI asks for a code, paste it below.
cfg_login_uvod: Click Login → Copy link → open the link on any computer and sign in. If the login asks for a code, paste it back here. After signing in the provider appears in the agent model list.
cfg_login_zalijepi_kod: Paste the code (if the login asks for one)
cfg_lokalni_model_naslov: Local model (Ollama) via API spawn — it works, but text only (no tools: Bash/files/MCP).
cfg_prov_uvod: Subscription providers (Claude) have no extra settings. A local one (Ollama) only needs the server IP:port — like RAG; the token is optional (only behind a reverse proxy).
cfg_ulaz_globalno_naslov: The global switch is off — every group behaves as if it were off.
cfg_ulaz_greska_citanja: Could not read the ingest gate
cfg_ulaz_nova_grupa_opis: A new group starts off — never on its own.
cfg_ulaz_opis_off: as today — the message goes straight to claude -p, the board is untouched
cfg_ulaz_opis_on: on — the message goes through the board: task → project → assignee → cost
cfg_ulaz_opis_shadow: shadow — the message goes as today, but what would be opened is logged
cfg_ulaz_prag_a: Threshold A — a task is opened
cfg_ulaz_prag_a_opis: Below the threshold (a greeting, a question) the answer goes out at once and the board stays clean. Default 16 (E2).
cfg_ulaz_prag_b_opis: Below the threshold a task gets a single assignee; above it goes research → plan → build → verify. Default 36 (E3).
cfg_ulaz_prag_c_opis: Above the threshold the plan is sent for approval and tasks are opened only once approved. Default 81 (E5).
cfg_ulaz_pragovi_rastu: The thresholds must increase: A ≤ B ≤ C.
cfg_ulaz_spremljeno: Saved — takes effect immediately, no restart
cfg_ulaz_ukljucena_opis: Off: every group works as today, regardless of the switch positions below.
cfg_ulaz_uvod: How a Telegram message enters the board — per group, three positions (off / shadow / on). The settings are stored in {putanja} and take effect immediately, without a restart — both the bridge and the board read the file on every pass. The manual brake (rule 17) still stops everything.
dez_greska_citanja: Could not read the standby settings: {greska}
dez_izvor_greska: {greska} — only the currently configured model is shown
dez_izvor_poznati: {broj} known models — another name can be typed in
dez_napomena_opis: A provider outside the local network is selected. If it does not answer, the standby sends a measured notice — it never silently falls back to Ollama, because the user would get someone else's answer under someone else's signature.
dez_naslov_aktivno: The primary model is down; the standby answers on Telegram.
dez_naslov_iskljucen: The trigger is disabled — standby will not start even past the error threshold.
dez_naslov_pripravnost: The primary path works; the standby is waiting.
dez_ollama_posluzitelj_opis: Where the model list is pulled from and where the standby's questions go.
dez_opis_anthropic: WARNING: Anthropic goes through claude -p and spends the SAME quota that summoned the standby in the first place.
dez_opis_ollama: Local Ollama — the only provider that works without a key and without the internet.
dez_opis_ostali: List source: models/model-config.json. The key is read from credentials.env; the board never displays its value.
dez_prag_gresaka_opis: A single passing error does not raise standby; {min}–{max}.
dez_provjera_opis: Actually calls the selected provider through the same bridge that answers on Telegram. Without it a wrong choice only shows up during an outage.
dez_razmak_straze_opis: How often the watch checks whether the primary path is back.
dez_smije_podici_opis: The standby's only action with consequences. Disabled: the podigni command refuses the restart and says so.
dez_spremljeno: Saved — takes effect immediately, no restart ({vrijeme})
dez_ukljuceno_opis: Disabled: errors are reported as before and the standby stays silent.
dez_uvod: When claude -p fails {n} times in a row, the standby takes over answering on Telegram and reports back as soon as the primary path returns. Settings are stored in {putanja} and take effect immediately, without a restart — both the bridge and the tool read the file on every call.
